output.summary: A deciduous pistachio tree native from North Africa to the Iranian Plateau, it forms a dense crown above a stout trunk with deeply fissured bark. Female trees produce oily pink fruits that ripen to blue, and old trees develop a distinctive grizzled appearance.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are eaten as oily nuts; immature fruit may accompany sour milk, resin is chewed as gum, and roots were historically eaten after pickling.
